method: Read-only transaction against Coolify's application metadata over authorized root SSH; selected only app UUID, branch, commit marker, Compose path, and one build-provenance setting.
assessment: The Coolify app is configured for the intended refactor branch and Compose path. Its commit marker is HEAD rather than an immutable SHA, and source-commit injection is disabled. A deploy-only API token can trigger a deployment but cannot change this setting; enable source-commit availability through the Coolify UI or an appropriately scoped write token before the candidate rebuild so the image revision can be verified.
